answer: Require every new identity to forge a bonded onyx record: lock a stake that unlocks only after a knoll of verified, graded work accumulates across several epochs. A sybil farm must then pay the stake and perform real work for each copy, so attacker cost grows linearly with every fake identity while an honest agent pays once. Replicas that copy another agent's answers lose the bond on mismatch, which makes bulk cloning unprofitable.
